references.text: God gives Abraham a similar blessing to become a great nation and that all the families of the earth shall be blessed in him.
God promises Abraham that his descendants will be as numerous as the stars in the sky.
God renews His promise to Abraham to make his descendants numerous and that all nations on earth will be blessed through his offspring.

God gives Jacob the promise that his descendants will become like the dust of the earth, spread out in every direction, and that all the families of the earth will be blessed through him and his offspring.
Paul explains that Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith and preached the gospel to Abraham: "In you shall all nations be blessed."
God confirms Abrahams covenant with Isaac by using identical star imagery to show the transfer of the promise.
The original covenant with Abraham (Gen 12) which is confirmed and transferred to Isaac in the source verse.
The first formulation of the promise that all families of the earth will be blessed, now confirmed for Isaac.
